recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If current implementations need manifest-like inline attachment guidance, open or use a current tracker against List, DocumentReference, or another active resource rather than reviving retired DocumentManifest content.
issue_request: FHIR-12655 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 change request asking to remove DocumentManifest.content.pAttachment because DocumentManifest is a manifest rather than a container; FM confirmed it no longer needed DocumentManifest for attachment workflows.
initial_application: Git commit 94e532a611046fcdc40df2d7d28457eeb7dad3a6 explicitly named GF#12655 in a San Diego WGM DocumentManifest block vote and changed the historical source from DocumentManifest.content.p[x] Attachment|Reference(Any) to direct DocumentManifest.content Reference(Any), also replacing pAttachment examples with DocumentReference references.
additional_context: FHIR-5877 originally added Attachment to DocumentManifest.content and FHIR-13534 was applied in the same block vote to broaden DocumentManifest prose; both already have combined-branch audit commits. Current source/fhir.ini lists DocumentManifest under removed resources, comments/drops old active entries, and maps DocumentManifest to List, while source/history.html records DocumentManifest as removed with use List and commit ea941737076615e7e2772299c80c63e1490f2e93 deleted source/documentmanifest.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested removal is already reflected in historical source history, current build scope has no active DocumentManifest.content element, and remaining pAttachment-style hits are old release snapshots under tools/history that should not be rewritten.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue that added Attachment to DocumentManifest.content; already audited on the combined branch and superseded by FHIR-12655.
